recommendation: Keep the commit. No further core terminology change is recommended for FHIR-20639; future additions to DeviceNameType should be handled through their own Jira decisions rather than restoring model-name.
issue_request: FHIR-20639 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested better Device.name.type definitions by replacing the older DeviceNameType list with registered-name, user-friendly-name, and patient-reported-name, removing values such as manufacturer-name, model-name, and other.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by November 2021 commits cae641cfad and c4a95b2b91, with dc516986c5 cited in Jira, replacing the DeviceNameType CodeSystem and updating Device and DeviceDefinition name type text.
additional_context: Later FHIR-43164 intentionally made Device.name.type and DeviceDefinition.deviceName.type extensible CodeableConcept bindings, and later FHIR-47605 added commercial-brand-family. FHIR-40455 subsequently added active DeviceAssociation examples whose contained Device.name.type codings used the removed model-name code.
reconciliation: Changed the six active DeviceAssociation examples to use http://hl7.org/fhir/device-nametype#user-friendly-name instead of a bare model-name coding, preserving the later extensible binding and commercial-brand-family addition.
